log.msg: Done and committed 31e4c0aaa: started/ended rename; Lineage.js samples children of agents' claude.exe each 10 s tick (Processes.trace), cap 60/min/owner. Measured live: 3,4,12 new descendants per 10 s sample (~38 starts + ~42 ends a minute across 7 agents). Next: leaks.mjs + report, then the Chrome-pin test.

Leak cause 1 (148 browser 'found gone' ends): a script that called process.exit() ran Browser.mjs's exit hook, which killed chrome but wrote no end line; the async 'browser closed' post died with the process. Fix in Server/Browser.mjs: the exit hook writes the end line synchronously, once.

Leak cause 2: Server/browser-watchdog.mjs closed an orphan chrome and exited without an end line. Fix: it writes the end line (from the start line's own fields) when it closes the browser, and when it finds launcher and browser already gone. It kills only while the pid's command line still matches OUR_CHROME (a reused pid is never killed).

Leak cause 3 (160 server 'found gone' ends, mostly qf-1..qf-8): taskkill /T /F of a wrapper skips the exit hooks of the run.js / server.js / health starts inside the tree. Fix: new Lifecycle.end_killed(dir, why, {skip_id}) ends every open server/health/browser start under the killed path whose pid is dead; Lifecycle.close() and Pool.kill(pid, expect, slot) call it.

Safety holes closed on the same paths: Lifecycle --stop <pid> could end the owner's Chrome; kill() trusted a stored pid. New owners_own()/OUR_CHROME in Lifecycle.js refuse Chrome without a Playwright marker, Code, Figma and similar. Servex/chrome-pin.test.mjs proves Lifecycle.resources/kill, Processes.reap, Relief, Pool.kill, the watchdog and Browser's exit hook never pick them and do pick a Playwright chrome.

Report: leaks/report.md (generated by node Servex/leaks.mjs --write, plus causes). No live process is a leak: 0 alive with owner done, 13 alive with owner working, 1 gone (a junk line the processes test wrote into process-monitor/task.jsonl in the main tree; cause fixed with SERVEX_LINEAGE=0, line left: append-only). Also touched Server/browser-watchdog.mjs (not in the fence list; it is the Browser close path).
